zh.l1: 一天里，要盯的东西太多了。让一座小岛，替你盯着。
zh.l2: 早上八点半，今天的待办，抬头就在。
zh.l3: 十点有会。日程和月历都在岛上，到点一键加入。
zh.l4: 中午，QQ、微信、邮件的新消息，岛上直接看。
zh.l5: 下午，Claude Code 等你确认，点一下就批准。
zh.l6: 复制过的东西，都留在剪贴板里。
zh.l7: 看不懂的句子，顺手就翻译。
zh.l8: 到了晚上，歌词跟着音乐，一句一句地走。
zh.l9: 浮屿，Windows 上的桌面灵动岛。开源，免费。

en.l1: There's too much to keep an eye on in a day. Let one small island watch it for you.
en.l2: Half past eight. Today's to-dos are right where you look.
en.l3: A meeting at ten. Your schedule and calendar live on the island, and you join with one click.
en.l4: At noon, new messages from QQ, WeChat and mail show up right on the island.
en.l5: In the afternoon, Claude Code waits for your OK. One click approves it.
en.l6: Everything you copied stays in the clipboard.
en.l7: And a sentence you can't read gets translated on the spot.
en.l8: At night, the lyrics follow the music, line by line.
en.l9: Fuyu. A dynamic island for the Windows desktop. Free and open source.
